Normal sudoku rules apply.

Digits along an arrow must sum to the digit in that arrow's circle.

Adjacent digits along the green line must differ by at least 5.

The purple line contains a non-repeating set of consecutive digits in any order.

Box borders divide the blue line into segments with the same sum.

Adjacent digits along the yellow line cannot be consecutive.
